text: The harvest festival fills the market square with lanterns, music and the smell of roasting chestnuts.

outcomes.text: A fortune-teller grabs your hand and whispers a good omen.
A night of laughter and aching feet.
The crowd buys a few trinkets. Easy money.

text: A traveling alchemist sets down a wooden chest of pills and names a fair price.

outcomes.text: A good price for a good pill.

choices.label: Buy a Qi Gathering Pill (35 gold)

outcomes.text: The pill's scent alone makes your qi stir.
The alchemist is impressed with your questions and gives you a pill for free.
A pleasant hour passes.

text: A wandering monk with a cracked staff asks for a bowl of rice and a place to sleep.

choices.label: Share your meal and your roof

outcomes.text: In the morning the monk leaves a few words that rearrange your thinking.
He eats heartily, thanks you and leaves at dawn.
You close the door. Somewhere, a debt is noted.

text: The river bursts its banks and a village downstream is swept into chaos.

outcomes.text: You carry child after child to the high ground. The village will never forget it.
The current is too strong. You save a few and almost drown.

choices.label: Send supplies from a safe distance (20 gold)

outcomes.text: A modest kindness.

text: A smoky back room hums with dice and loud laughter. A seat at the table is open.

choices.label: Bet big (all you can afford, up to 50)

outcomes.text: The dice love you tonight.
The dice do not love you.

choices.label: Watch the players and learn their tells

outcomes.text: You learn more about people than about dice.
Discipline is its own jackpot.

text: At a busy teahouse, you overhear whispers of a hidden spirit spring a day's walk away.

outcomes.text: The spring is real. You drink deeply and feel your qi swell.
It is a trap set by thieves.
A damp hole in the ground and nothing more.
You drink your tea in peace.

text: A thin child sits shivering at your gate, with no one to claim them and nowhere to go.

choices.label: Take them in as your own

outcomes.text: The child clings to your sleeve. From that day, the house is a little louder and a lot warmer.

choices.label: Find them a place at a temple

outcomes.text: You leave a donation and a promise to visit.
You walk on, and the weight of it follows you.

text: A master blacksmith, tired of mortal customers, offers to forge something for a cultivator who can pay.

outcomes.text: Three weeks later, the saber is ready, cold and beautiful.
The blacksmith hammers out a shirt of iron-boar hide plates.

choices.label: Watch him work and ask questions

outcomes.text: He grunts at you, but answers.

text: In a great city, you find a library whose keeper allows visitors for a small fee.

choices.label: Pay 10 gold and study for a season

outcomes.text: A dusty scroll holds a gem of a technique.
Months of reading leave your mind sharper.
You copy several pages unseen.
A night-watchman catches you and gives you a good beating.

text: A bandit king rules the mountain pass, and travelers pay tolls or lose their carts.

outcomes.text: You defeat him in single combat, and the pass is yours to use freely.
The king's blade finds you.
A small cost for a safe road.
The detour costs you a year of time.

text: In a hollow tree, you find a speckled egg that thrums faintly with qi.

outcomes.text: The egg hatches into a tiny spirit beast that nuzzles your hand. Its luck rubs off on you.
The egg stays cold. You bury it with a small ceremony.
A collector pays handsomely.

text: A fever spreads through a mountain village, and the healers have run out of medicine.

outcomes.text: The pills turn the tide. Elders weep and press blessings upon you.
The antidote cures the worst cases.
You work for weeks and are spared the fever.
You catch the fever and barely recover.
You hurry away.

text: An old jade carver offers to make you a ring for a fair price.

choices.label: Commission a Bronze Focus Ring (90 gold)

outcomes.text: A simple ring, but it quiets your thoughts.

choices.label: Ask him to teach you instead

outcomes.text: You learn patience, mostly.

text: A thunderstorm traps you in a dry cave for three days. The rhythm of the rain begins to feel like breathing.

choices.label: Meditate to the rhythm of the rain

outcomes.text: Your qi falls into step with the storm.
A calm few days, if not a productive one.

text: You wake to find a thief rifling through your belongings.

outcomes.text: You catch him by the collar and he drops everything.
He slips your grasp and takes some of your gold.
He bows and flees. Your purse is lighter.

text: A young hotshot publicly challenges you to a duel, hoping to make a name for himself.

outcomes.text: You win without too much trouble, and the crowd roars.
He is better than he looked. You lose face and some health.
The crowd boos. You do not mind.

text: The ground shudders and half a hillside slides toward the road you are walking on.

outcomes.text: You dive clear as boulders crash behind you.
A rock clips you as you dive.
